native_solver: MSL LocalLinearSystem with Eigen SparseLU, native unmodified library build
driver: Original private application; reads native mesh/data, invokes DiffusionCGProblem assembly and solve, exports fields and verifies native uneliminated reactions
comparison_scope: Same PDE, material and boundary data as the Cartesian Q1 MHM layer-36 case. Distinct approximation spaces: global conforming triangular P1 reference versus broken local quadrilateral Q1 MHM with continuous piecewise P1 macroface trace.
quadrature: Native order 2; exact stiffness quadrature because each triangle lies in one constant SPE10 pixel

records.timing_scope: Native mesh/data read, assembly, solve, reaction reassembly and binary export; not a controlled performance benchmark
records.discretization: MSL_CG global conforming triangular P1; SW-NE diagonals; native Eigen SparseLU; raw flux -K grad(p)
records.permeability_convention: Kx = Ky from unmodified layer 36; piecewise constant on 60 x 220 pixels
records.units: Original SPE10 numerical coordinates in ft and permeability in mD; no SI conversion
records.reaction_convention: Outward Darcy reaction is minus the uneliminated native stiffness residual at essential nodes; side zero flux is natural, not a pointwise raw-gradient constraint
records.sample_convention: Pixel centers: lower triangle at diagonal and positive coordinate side at fine-grid boundaries. Profiles x=199: eleven macro intervals retain their separate interior-side endpoint flux limits. Samples are visualization data, not L2 norms.
records.native_reaction_check: Native uneliminated LCS action checked against independent exact triangular P1 gradients and archived pixel coefficients; no native matrix or solve altered
records.raw_flux_boundary_convention: Raw P1 flux is not H(div)-conforming and its boundary integrals need not equal the variational reactions; zero side flux is imposed naturally in the weak equation
records.energy_identity: Integral q.K^-1.q equals minus the bottom outward reaction for p_bottom=1, p_top=0 and homogeneous side Neumann data

limitations: Numerical references, not exact solutions. Integrated consecutive-grid changes quantify observed refinement sensitivity, not a certified error bound.
Raw P1 flux -K grad(p) is piecewise constant, with normal jumps; variational reaction balance does not imply fine-cell or pointwise conservation.
Pixel-center/profile samples use deterministic one-sided triangle values and are visualization data, not quadrature norms.

consecutive_rates.definition: log2 of consecutive integrated differences, not exact-solution error rates
